title: Nutty Creamy Ethiopian Chinese Leaf Stew
description: A hearty and aromatic stew featuring Chinese leaf, char-grilled yang, and a blend of Ethiopian spices, finished with a creamy and nutty sauce. This dish showcases the unique fusion of Ethiopian and Chinese flavors.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the Chinese leaf and cook until wilted, about 3 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the yang paste, berbere spice, salt, and black pepper.
Add the spice mixture to the pot and stir to combine.
Pour in the heavy cream and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and stir in the peanut butter until smooth.
Char-grill the yang paste in a small pan over high heat for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir the char-grilled yang paste into the stew and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
